scale: 1–5, higher is better; internal judgement, not empirical learning impact. Essential corrections ordered ahead of weighted preference.

records.title: One course-home route
records.evidence: Native Safari and probe: five “coming later” notices, zero platform return links on old home.
records.proposal: Keep Lesson1 teaching untouched; add a consistent return-to-CBD catalog and reconcile review availability labels.
records.benefit: Learners retain orientation and discover the actual next lessons.
records.interaction: Header return restores catalog with focus on Lesson1 card; distinguish lesson home from curriculum home.
records.dependencies: Owner agrees navigation labels; preserve old root/activity routes.
records.acceptance: Catalog→L1→home→L2 works on keyboard/mobile; old exercise routes and progress keys unchanged.

records.title: Preserve draft work across content revisions
records.location: All nine builder screens; safeProgress version change
records.evidence: Synthetic prior-version draft missing from downloaded export; only checkpoint metadata survived.
records.proposal: Archive bounded prior-version drafts before resetting current mastery; show a version-difference notice and offer export before transition.
records.benefit: Avoid loss of learner-created work without awarding new mastery.
records.interaction: A previous-work panel keeps text read-only until explicitly copied into a revised scaffold.
records.dependencies: Version schema, archived text bounds, recovery tests.
records.acceptance: Two version upgrades preserve all old text; current checkpoints reset; hostile/oversized input rejected; no silent overwrite.

records.title: Make an export actually recoverable by learners
records.evidence: Probe found no import control; exported JSON is a record, not an in-app restoration path.
records.proposal: Provide local validated import with preview, merge/replace choice and a pre-import export; preserve original lab key separately.
records.benefit: A browser-local product has a usable recovery route.
records.interaction: Choose file→validate→show lesson/version/draft differences→confirm local merge.
records.dependencies: E02; published data contract and negative fixtures.
records.acceptance: Restore on a clean origin; mixed versions and duplicate drafts previewed; wrong files/corrupt JSON fail without losing existing work.

records.title: Make resume and completion precise
records.location: CBD catalog and both learning shells
records.evidence: Live catalog shows “0 checkpoints recorded” with “Resume / review”; L1 has a separate progress system.
records.proposal: Show last meaningful position, checkpoint denominator and current-version state; label Start, Resume, Review completed checkpoint explicitly.
records.benefit: Reduce uncertainty without pretending there is one certified course score.
records.interaction: Card says “Resume: Objective briefing · 1/3 checks”; L1 progress adapter reads its existing key.
records.dependencies: Read-only adapters; no storage migration.
records.acceptance: Fresh/reading/partial/passed/migrated states have distinct labels; records remain separate and accurately described.

records.title: Put mobile learning before the full navigation rail
records.evidence: Probe puts L3 first teaching heading at785px on390px viewport and716px at768px; full rail precedes it.
records.proposal: Collapse the rail to a compact section selector and keep progress/export available behind a labelled disclosure.
records.benefit: Learners see the problem before repeated navigation.
records.interaction: One lesson/section line above content; expand path on demand; retain focus and aria-current.
records.dependencies: Existing approved layout/tokens.
records.acceptance: At390px first heading appears within first viewport; all path/export controls remain keyboard/touch reachable; 320px reflow.

records.title: Name draft feedback honestly and make it usable
records.evidence: All fields containing “x” receive the same self-review prompt; text explicitly says not automatically approved.
records.proposal: Rename action “Open self-review prompts”; display criteria beside each field, not as one generic paragraph.
records.benefit: Sets accurate expectations and helps learners inspect their own reasoning.
records.interaction: Missing fields receive linked prompts; completed fields show a concise self-check list and optional illustrative approach.
records.dependencies: Expert-approved prompts; preserve no automatic quality grade.
records.acceptance: Labels never imply semantic assessment; x/blank/strong drafts receive the appropriate completeness state and same transparent human rubric.

records.title: Create a readable study-work export
records.location: All builder outputs and course export
records.evidence: Current export is raw JSON; no learner-facing review sheet connects the nine drafts.
records.proposal: Add a printable/local HTML summary containing lesson, source, drafted fields, uncertainty and next practical task; retain JSON for recovery.
records.benefit: Learners and trainers can use the outputs in discussion.
records.interaction: Preview a print sheet; select lessons; retain pending/unvalidated labels; no upload or account.
records.dependencies: Stable draft labels; E02 must precede cross-version inclusion.
records.acceptance: Readable A4/PDF print output; long/Arabic text safe; HTML escaped; JSON unchanged; no facilitator solution included.

records.title: A connected evidence-to-decision notebook
records.location: L1 matrix→L2 objective→L3 logframe→L5 evaluation→L6 handover
records.evidence: Repeated invented review-routine context has no linked learner artifact; each scaffold begins independently.
records.proposal: Introduce a bounded local evidence notebook linking a finding, its uncertainty, a chosen objective, plan, review and transfer responsibility.
records.benefit: Develops traceable reasoning across the CBD cycle.
records.interaction: Reuse a learner-selected finding with explicit provenance; flag unsupported links; preserve alternative interpretations.
records.effort: 20–30 development days +8–12 design/expert days +6–10 QA days
records.dependencies: E02/E03; stable IDs; learner/facilitator evidence boundary.
records.acceptance: Follow one invented evidence item end to end, revise it and see downstream review flags; preserve alternate drafts and export; no AI correctness verdict.

records.title: A reviewable handoff to the existing workbench
records.evidence: Practical links work, but drafts are not mapped into workbench fields; learner must re-enter context.
records.proposal: Begin with a labelled handoff sheet and field mapping; later add explicit user-approved local copy with merge preview.
records.benefit: Reduces transcription effort while preserving original exercises and ownership.
records.interaction: Show “what you have / what the activity asks / what remains”; never write to lab storage on opening a link.
records.dependencies: E07 then E02/E03; original activity schemas and consent.
records.acceptance: Handoff previews exact fields; cancel leaves lab bytes/state unchanged; copied values remain learner-authored; all standalone modules still function.

records.title: Vary the learning rhythm by cognitive task
records.evidence: All38 repeat concept reveal→points→transcript→optional tool→decision→takeaway; mobile median main height3.1 viewports.
records.proposal: Use three deliberate patterns: explain/compare, investigate/decide, construct/reflect; remove duplicate headings and redundant prompts.
records.benefit: Variety follows the task and reduces avoidable scrolling.
records.interaction: A short orientation names the task; tools can lead a construction screen; keep optional explanations adjacent.
records.dependencies: Screen-purpose inventory; retain all source content/transcripts.
records.acceptance: Every screen retains objective/source/feedback; no hidden required content; comparative screenshots and scroll/task tests at390/768/1440.

records.title: Give frameworks their actual relational structure
records.evidence: New “chain/compare/cycle” styling still uses similar text buttons; columns and feedback loops remain mostly prose.
records.proposal: Build specific system, row/column and iteration representations using current semantic HTML/SVG conventions.
records.benefit: A learner sees which relationships matter rather than a list of terms.
records.interaction: Logframe shows result/measure/source/assumption across one row; SARA allows returning with new evidence; accessible text equivalents.
records.dependencies: E10; source-expert review of each relationship.
records.acceptance: User can explain a relationship without opening every definition; keyboard/touch equivalents and no color-only/drag-only meaning.

records.title: Transparent review of learner reasoning
records.evidence: Completeness feedback is accurate but cannot identify a weak result/measure link or unsupported claim.
records.proposal: Add transparent self/peer/facilitator rubrics and revision comparison. Start with authored checks, not an AI grade.
records.benefit: Turns drafted text into an inspectable learning product.
records.interaction: Learner marks evidence for each criterion, requests a peer challenge and records a reasoned revision; reviewer identity optional/local.
records.effort: 12–18 development days +8–12 expert/design days +5–8 QA days
records.dependencies: E07/E08; permissions for any future sharing; agreed rubric.
records.acceptance: No machine semantic pass; show criteria and unresolved judgements; blank/x drafts cannot be represented as externally reviewed; offline local mode preserved.

records.title: An evolving, bounded professional case
records.evidence: Examples recur but choices do not change later information or demand revisiting an earlier judgement.
records.proposal: Use a small expert-authored invented case with two evidence updates and two defensible paths; keep it separate from official scenario solutions.
records.benefit: Practises adapting professional judgement under uncertainty.
records.interaction: Record initial hypothesis, reveal contradictory information, revise plan with reasons and compare consequences.
records.effort: 15–25 development days +10–15 expert/design days +6–10 QA days
records.dependencies: E11/E12; case authorship and review; no procedural fiction represented as doctrine.
records.acceptance: At least two reasoned paths, no simplistic optimal score; state/reset/accessibility tests; debrief exposes assumptions without revealing facilitator keys.

records.title: Teach ties and sensitivity explicitly
records.evidence: All-zero weights produce two0 totals presented as an ordered list; ties have no explicit interpretation.
records.proposal: Label ties and zero-information weighting; let learners compare two weighting sets and state a reason for preference.
records.benefit: Prevents arithmetic from appearing to settle professional priority.
records.interaction: Disable rank language when all weights are zero; show constraints and before/after rank movement.
records.dependencies: Source separation from official participant chart.
records.acceptance: Zero/all-equal/tied values have explicit feedback; constraint cannot disappear behind a total; same result via keyboard.

records.title: Turn risk rating into response reasoning
records.evidence: Changing likelihood/impact updates a product and generic paragraph; no prevention/impact response is represented in the grid.
records.proposal: Add one invented risk and compare prevention, mitigation and contingency effects with rationale and owner.
records.benefit: Connects classification with action rather than color/score.
records.interaction: Keep source-defined3×3 axes; show selected current/residual assumptions and a review trigger, never automatic acceptance.
records.dependencies: Expert ratings; E11; safeguards against false precision.
records.acceptance: Low-likelihood/severe event still prompts action; no universal acceptance threshold; accessible table alternative.

records.title: Use checkpoints for retrieval and justification
records.location: All78 checkpoint items across six lessons
records.evidence: Fresh journeys pass; retries can converge by feedback, while reasons are not retained; L1 and later feedback differ.
records.proposal: Retain mastery thresholds; add a short rationale/retrieval prompt for selected applied items and delayed return after a meaningful error.
records.benefit: Distinguishes remembered reasoning from answer-position convergence.
records.interaction: After a relevant wrong choice, link to a precise concept and ask for a brief reason before another attempt; no essay auto-score.
records.dependencies: Item blueprint; E12; maintain saved completion compatibility.
records.acceptance: No reduction in standard; unknown/incorrect/correct/review/refresh paths pass; expert maps each item to an objective and judges ambiguity.

records.title: Storyboard before producing the14 new scenes
records.evidence: Three existing scenes pair context and concept; new briefs repeat meetings/blank documents and some teaching prompts are generic per lesson.
records.proposal: Produce small non-final storyboards after the interaction design; make each scene pose a different observable dilemma; stage optional scenes.
records.benefit: Preserves cinematic quality while avoiding repetitive costly imagery.
records.interaction: Place an observation prompt before the image and a return question after the concept; retain around2–3 useful opportunities per lesson.
records.dependencies: E10/E13; image rights and cost authorization.
records.acceptance: Owner compares storyboard purposes, alt text and placement; no scene ships merely to meet a quota; files/rights/alt audited.

records.title: A bounded institutional demo, not a course inside a course
records.evidence: Selector can open the entire gated Lesson2 inside a750px iframe; long page mixes evidence and funding.
records.proposal: Create a three-minute guide: problem→one evidence contradiction→one learner output→honest readiness/partnership ask.
records.benefit: Stakeholders see the product’s educational value without becoming lost in navigation.
records.interaction: Use actual isolated components or fixed steps; offer full course separately; evidence/status legend stays visible.
records.dependencies: E07/E11; agree stakeholder audience.
records.acceptance: All demo paths finish without checkpoint gating or nested-scroll traps; claims match evidence; budgets unchanged unless scoped.

records.title: Separate reading, practice and practical review
records.location: Catalog, rails and final lesson screens
records.evidence: Only checkpoint completion is recorded; tools are optional and a blank draft can be skipped.
records.proposal: Display a lightweight preparation checklist: concepts explored, draft present, self-review done, practical discussion pending.
records.benefit: Makes the learning journey legible without equating participation and competence.
records.interaction: Learner-controlled checklist, no compulsory extra score and no claims of observed workplace skill.
records.dependencies: E04/E12; scope agreed by owner.
records.acceptance: A blank/skipped/passed path is accurately labelled; access remains independent; no inflation of qualification.

records.title: Readable source information on demand
records.evidence: Raw filenames and page strings provide traceability but look like development metadata during study.
records.proposal: Show a compact source label with a disclosure for title/edition/pages; keep internal hashes in manifests.
records.benefit: Less reading clutter with intact provenance.
records.interaction: “Source: CBD Lesson3, pp5–7” opens citation detail; do not publish facilitator PDF.
records.dependencies: Public reference policy.
records.acceptance: Every source remains reachable and edition clear; no private path/facilitator material appears.

records.title: Define a deliberate offline distribution profile
records.location: New JSON runtime versus independent original workbenches
records.evidence: Local-served build works; this is not evidence of reliable cached offline return after internet loss.
records.proposal: Specify either a downloadable local pack or a versioned offline cache only after operating context is agreed.
records.benefit: Avoids misleading offline expectations and stale mixed lessons.
records.interaction: Package integrity and update notice first; any service worker requires atomic asset-version recovery.
records.effort: 6–10 days for a bounded pack; caching12–20 days
records.dependencies: Owner identifies device/storage topology; media size and rights.
records.acceptance: Disconnect/restart/update/rollback under agreed topology; no stale script/audio pairing; original workbenches preserved.

records.title: Independent assisted-user acceptance
records.location: Keyboard, screen-reader, touch and error/recovery journeys
records.evidence: Current sampled Axe reports are clean; no full assistive-technology or physical-device acceptance is established.
records.proposal: Run a bounded native Safari/VoiceOver and physical iOS/Android acceptance protocol before any compliance claim.
records.benefit: Finds reading/focus/form issues automation misses.
records.interaction: Test navigation, feedback announcements, long drafts, resizing, table scrolling and recovery with representative users when authorised.
records.effort: 4–7 QA/accessibility days plus participants by approval
records.dependencies: E01/E05; explicitly not the deferred field-effectiveness pilot.
records.acceptance: Document task outcomes and unresolved access barriers; no full WCAG claim from Axe alone.

records.title: Bring construction back into Lesson1 selectively
records.evidence: L1 has richer framework identity and audio, but most outputs stop at exploration/choice.
records.proposal: Use the shared bounded draft pattern for a single evidence note and uncertainty explanation, preserving approved visuals/audio.
records.benefit: Connects the best Run02 innovation with the approved opening experience.
records.interaction: Record observation/source/uncertainty beside triangulation, then optionally select a matrix cell.
records.dependencies: E08; owner specifically approves any Lesson1 edit.
records.acceptance: No Lesson1 text/audio/key regression; one output can feed a chosen next task without exposing scenario answers.

records.title: Versioned content contract and factual build checks
records.location: tools/validate-content.cjs, two lesson JSON files, duplicated shells
records.evidence: Data-driven core is practical; validation mainly checks shape/counts, and legacy/shared shells drift in copy and state.
records.proposal: Document one content contract and use stable section/screen IDs for changes; add cross-route/status and migration tests.
records.benefit: Reduces regressions without a framework rewrite.
records.interaction: Keep data files initially; add schema/editor tooling only when authors need it.
records.dependencies: E02/E04; content-owner workflow.
records.acceptance: Invalid source links/status/version references fail; edits do not reorder saved work silently; two-shell routes covered.

records.title: Explain revisions once with useful differences
records.location: All screens after a content-version change
records.evidence: The version notice repeats above every screen and states checkpoint retention but not draft consequences.
records.proposal: Show a persistent concise revision badge plus a detailed difference summary on first entry.
records.benefit: Learners understand why review is needed without rereading a full warning.
records.interaction: List changed screens, retained notes and checks to repeat; dismissal does not erase access.
records.dependencies: E02 must be resolved first.
records.acceptance: Migrated/fresh/return states show accurate information; no claim old drafts survive until they do.

records.title: Expose local drafting limits and intent
records.evidence: Length is capped in UI/load validation but there is no remaining-count cue; generic green feedback resembles success.
records.proposal: Show remaining characters near the limit and neutral self-review status; retain safe local text guidance.
records.benefit: Avoids surprise truncation and over-reading a completion cue.
records.interaction: Counter appears near limit; no remote analysis or new data collection.
records.dependencies: E06; text-scaling/RTL checks.
records.acceptance: Pasted oversized content explains the cap; punctuation/RTL safe; no hidden silent shortening across restore.

records.title: Motion only for meaningful state change
records.location: Concept selection, risk cell and field review
records.evidence: Current movement is restrained; no evidence of a general animation problem.
records.proposal: If added, use brief highlight/connector emphasis for changed evidence or parameter effect.
records.benefit: Attention follows the consequence of an action.
records.interaction: 150–250ms state emphasis with reduced-motion instant alternative, no delayed content.
records.dependencies: E11/E15 first.
records.acceptance: No content hidden waiting for animation; keyboard/reduced-motion equivalent; no added motion solely for premium appearance.

records.title: Do not auto-grade policing judgement with a new AI service
records.evidence: Local scaffolds explicitly avoid semantic grading; no rubric-validity evidence or external-data permission exists.
records.proposal: Retain transparent human judgement; reject automatic pass/fail and unapproved external draft transmission.
records.benefit: Protects integrity, privacy and institutional credibility.
records.interaction: Possible future advisory hints require separate evidence, consent and uncertainty controls.
records.effort: Not estimated as an authorised build
records.dependencies: Explicit future scope/privacy/validation decision.
records.acceptance: No AI-generated certification, opaque score or new provider egress in the next release.

records.title: Do not migrate frameworks or require accounts now
records.location: Static platform and curriculum readiness entries
records.evidence: The present core renders another curriculum fixture; no present blocker justifies an LMS/auth rewrite.
records.proposal: Keep incremental shared components; defer accounts, SCORM/xAPI and CMS migration until an institutional integration requirement exists.
records.benefit: Preserves speed and no-login access while containing operational cost.
records.interaction: Agree an interoperability contract before selecting infrastructure.
records.dependencies: Institutional requirements and data ownership.
records.acceptance: No new compulsory login, tracking or unrelated dependency in the bounded improvement release.

records.title: Do not commission every media opportunity at once
records.evidence: Specifications are not actual media; current validation/rights and scene differentiation remain open.
records.proposal: Validate the changed interaction and commission a small approved batch first.
records.benefit: Avoids paying for narration/art that must be regenerated after authoring changes.
records.interaction: Joint script/media hash governance and staged listening/visual acceptance.
records.dependencies: E17; explicit generation-cost permission and rights.
records.acceptance: No automatic generation during build; source/recording version pairs and actual acceptance recorded.

records.title: Stabilise the initial catalog layout
records.evidence: Three cold-cache Chromium trials each recorded lab CLS0.378 on the catalog; course landing0.000 under the same stated emulation. Not a field CWV result.
records.proposal: Reserve a representative catalog skeleton/minimum geometry or render static catalog structure before hydration; avoid shifting the footer and primary regions when data appears.
records.benefit: A lightweight page also feels visually settled and predictable.
records.interaction: Show stable structural placeholders with immediately visible readable content; respect reduced motion.
records.dependencies: Keep no-framework architecture; repeat the exact performance protocol.
records.acceptance: Three cold-cache repeats under the documented protocol show no large catalog insertion shift; target lab CLS≤0.1 without delaying content or hiding it.
